name: channel-compile-scaling
measures: witwin.channel.scene.compile on a warm cache, against structure count
rationale: compile reads all four Core version properties before consulting its cache, so a cache hit still walks the whole world model and every solve pays it again. Solver benchmarks cannot see this: they compile one scene once, outside the timing loop.

protocol.statistic_rationale: For host-bound work the best sample is the cleanest estimate of real cost. Medians drift with unrelated machine load; across four consecutive runs the minimum held scaling_ratio to 4.058-4.076 and version_share to 1.009-1.012.

scaling_ratio.meaning: compile time at 1024 structures divided by compile time at 256. Linear is 4.0 and quadratic is 16.0.
scaling_ratio.catches: an algorithmic regression in the traversal or the cache key
scaling_ratio.does_not_catch: a constant-factor regression, which stays linear

calibrated_per_structure.meaning: per-structure microseconds divided by a fixed Python workload timed in the same process, so host CPU speed divides out.
calibrated_per_structure.catches: a constant-factor regression, including the O(1)-to-O(N) version-property change this gate was written for. Restoring the pre-optimization traversal measures 0.0432 on this scene, which fails by 1.7x while the current implementation passes with 2x headroom.
calibrated_per_structure.does_not_catch: a uniform slowdown of both compile and the calibration workload

version_share.meaning: warm compile time divided by the cost of reading the four version properties alone.
version_share.catches: a second O(N) pass added to compile
version_share.does_not_catch: the version walk itself becoming slower, which calibrated_per_structure covers

max_per_structure_us.meaning: raw per-structure microseconds. Depends on host CPU and Python build, so it is recorded for trend reading rather than gated.
max_per_structure_us.regression_reference: 54.7 with the pre-optimization traversal on this scene

reference_environment.note: Only max_per_structure_us is environment-sensitive. The three gating budgets are ratios and hold on other hosts.

open: This gate bounds the constant factor; it does not require the walk to leave the cache-hit path. Removing it there changes the ADR-034 invalidation contract, not just its cost.
